jobs.name: a-corner-hud.png
jobs.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup, a high-fidelity full-screen combat HUD redesign for the original Chinese fantasy game Rongboy. Edit the supplied real gameplay screenshot. Preserve its real subjective game camera, corridor perspective, warm rooms, floor and lights, muted sage-green needle-felt plush zombies with sewn round button eyes, shadowed third enemy, and foreground felt green garden-sprayer shotgun with coral wide tip and hands entering at lower right. Keep the actual game art, geometry, weapons, and position of camera; the focus is HUD. Dark green and oat/cream with muted saffron and coral in understated textile stitching details. Imagine the left near plush zombie was wounded a moment ago, with 4 of 6 health. Right near plush and background enemies have no overlay above or below them. Player visibly has 2 of 3 hearts and shotgun ammunition is 1 loaded and 20 reserve. Completely clear ALL existing UI from the reference, including the upper corners, timer, wound indicators and title, upper left mission box, center text boxes at and beneath the crosshair, zzz lettering, entire lower right weapon details and equipment panel, lower left pause legend, lower middle key hints, and any other labels. Rebuild clean visible background where those removed UI were. No browser chrome, headings, mission panels, timestamps, labels, key prompts or power countdowns. A compact lower arrangement and the one enemy health indicator only. Small cream four-notch reticle at screen center, exactly preserved in all versions, one distance color-neutral. HEALTH player icons must read as two SOLID coral-red felt hearts and one unmistakably EMPTY cream outline heart. AMMO numbers must read exactly "1 / 20", with 1 the dominant higher contrast figure, 20 smaller. No text besides those ammunition numbers, no extra digits. Clean readable margins attached to viewport as described. In-game purposeful, not landing page or illustration, no descriptions or callouts. Landscape near 16:9, full-bleed playable frame. Variant A: Classic corner layout. Small unobtrusive row of three sturdy fabric hearts bottom left, inset by 3.5% of width and 5% height, simple coral filled and outline icons with minimal stitched edges and subtle shadows. Bottom right carries only a small instantly recognizable three-bore shotgun silhouette followed by legible standalone off-white "1 / 20", no box behind it. Make the larger 1 prominent but less than 4.5% of screen height. Give it strong contrast with game surface. It sits above and inboard of the weapon's lower grip so it is readable in motion. The left wounded zombie has a single short, low-profile 6-part AMBER horizontal bar centered above its head with 4 filled segments on the left, 2 empty dark segments on the right. Each segment separated by a tight seam of tiny spacing, no badge, letter, number or black floating box. The health bar is only about 6% of screen width and located above that one zombie with clear space between bar and hair. On right zombie no bar. Strong hierarchy. Keep all top corners and middle of the screen blank of UI except the central reticle and the one thin enemy bar.
